text:
Jordan (CS): customer on enterprise plan hit repeated 504s and says there are no IDs in the UI. they sent a screenshot of the error page
Elliot (Platform Eng): can you ask for either a span token or a HAR — easiest for us is a span token header (x-rw-span) or a full HAR of the failing request
Jordan (CS): customer is non-technical. what's the simplest ask i can give them?
Elliot (Platform Eng): shortest path for non-tech users: 1) open the page showing the error 2) press Ctrl+Shift+E (or Cmd+Option+E on mac) to open DevTools -> Network tab 3) refresh the page and click the network row for the failing call to /v1/generate (or the API call you use) 4) in Headers look for a response header named `x-rw-span` or a request header `x-request-span` — copy that value and paste here. If they can't find it, ask them to right-click the network row -> Save all as HAR and upload
Kiran (Oncall): nit: some customers have proxies that strip our headers. if they don't see a span token, HAR + timestamp is the next best thing (include local timezone). also ask for the exact local time they hit the error and the user email/id so we can correlate logs
Jordan (CS): sample message i can paste to the customer:

"Hi — sorry about the interruption. Can you either (A) copy the value of the `x-rw-span` response header from the failing request in your browser DevTools (Network tab) and paste it here, or (B) if that's hard, export a HAR (Network -> right-click -> Save all as HAR) and attach it. Please also include the approximate local time you saw the 504 and the user email/ID. We’ll delete any sensitive data after troubleshooting. Thanks!"

Elliot (Platform Eng): for engineers — sample curl to reproduce if they can run it:

```
curl -v 'https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \ 
  -H 'x-rw-span: 8a7f3c2d4e5b6a1f' \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

Elliot (Platform Eng): if they can run the curl please ask them to run with `-v` and paste the full verbose output — that shows headers both directions. if they can’t share Authorization values, they can replace the token with `<REDACTED>` but keep the rest
Kiran (Oncall): if the customer prefers mobile/webview steps: ask them to capture SDK logs (set SDK log level to DEBUG), reproduce the error, then upload logs. our mobile SDKs log a `span_token` line when a request is sent — search logs for `span_token=`
tracebot: incident 2026-03-17-11874 created and linked to ticket #12345 (auto) :gear:
Jordan (CS): great, i'll send the short customer message and include an offer to walk them through the DevTools steps over video call if needed. thanks all :thumbsup:
Elliot (Platform Eng): one more: remind them to remove any PII from HAR before uploading if they prefer. if they can't, provide a secure upload link (ask support infra) and mark the upload as private in the ticket
